Objective · who is who at check-in
New words · people

You are the passenger. The agent helps you.

passengerPASS-en-ger · a person who travels on a plane
agentAY-jent · the person who helps you at the counter

Say it: “The passenger shows a passport to the agent.”

Objective · name things for a trip
Learn and repeat · things

Things for the trip 🎒

passportPASS-port · /ˈpɑːspɔːrt/

You show it at check-in.

ticketTICK-et · /ˈtɪkɪt/

Your flight ticket.

suitcaseSUIT-case · /ˈsuːtkeɪs/

You pack your things in it.

airportAIR-port · /ˈerpɔːrt/

We wait at the airport.

flightFLIGHT · /flaɪt/

Our flight is at 09:45.

seatSEAT · /siːt/

I like a window seat.

Objective · name trip actions
New words · verbs

Four verbs for your trip — look, listen and say 🔊

packPACK · /pæk/

You put your things in a suitcase.

I pack my suitcase the night before.

bookBOOK · /bʊk/

You buy your ticket online before the trip.

I book my ticket on the app.

boardBOARD · /bɔːd/

You get on the plane.

We board the plane at gate B7.

check inCHECK IN · /tʃek ɪn/

You show your passport at the counter.

I check in two hours early.

Objective · grammar: future with be going to
Grammar · from your school book

Talk about future trips: be going to + verb

Mega Goal 3 · Unit 3 “Far and Away” · Form, Meaning and Function

＝ Yes · positive

I am / you are / he is going to + verb

I’m going to visit AlUla.

－ No · negative

am not / isn’t / aren’t going to + verb

We aren’t going to fly.

？ Question

Are you going to …? — Yes, I am. / No, I’m not.

Are you going to travel in December?

Say it out loud: I’m going to visit AlUla. · We’re going to fly to Jeddah. · Are you going to go by car?

Objective · role-play the whole dialogue
Role-play · your show time 🎭

Say it all by yourself!

Traveler
Can I have a window seat, please?
Agent
I’m sorry, no window seats. Is an aisle seat OK?
Traveler
Yes, that’s fine. Thank you!
Agent
Here’s your boarding pass. Gate B7. Have a nice flight!

Rounds: 1 · teacher = agent → 2 · student = agent → 3 · you say it ALL — no looking!

Objective · review vocabulary & expressions
Review

Today’s key points

New words

  • airport / flight / ticket
  • passport / suitcase / seat
  • window seat / aisle seat
  • boarding pass / gate
  • passenger / agent
  • pack / book / board / check in

New expressions

  • Grammar: be going to + verb
  • Where are you going? — I’m going to visit AlUla.
  • I’m going to visit ___.
  • Are you going to fly? — Yes, I am.
  • I’d like to check in, please.
  • May I have your passport?
  • Can I have a window seat, please?
  • Here’s your boarding pass. Gate B7. Have a nice flight!
